content: Hermes auto-compression is configured via dedicated YAML config keys: `compression.enabled` (boolean toggle), `compression.threshold` (float, e.g. 0.7), `compression.target_ratio` (float, e.g. 0.2), `compression.protect_last_n` (int, number of recent messages to preserve), `compression.protect_first_n` (int, number of initial messages to preserve), and requires `context.engine` to be set to `compressor` to activate the compression context engine.
